collection_policy: One observation pass: one runs listing per requested head and one jobs listing per returned run; six GET requests total. No retries, waits, reruns, comments, or workflow changes.
normalization: Run/job/step statuses, conclusions, names and timestamps are copied from GitHub responses without inference. Unrelated repository/user payloads and endpoint links are omitted. Requests have separate observation timestamps.
